newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish January reserves rise to 96.3 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: Danish January reserves rise to 96.3 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 96.3 billion crowns at end-January 1997 from 84.5 billion crowns at end-December 1996, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Tuesday.

NOTE - In a statement the Central Bank said it had paid back a net 2.1 billion crowns of foreign loans in January. Six analysts polled by Reuters had on average expected Denmark's foreign reserves to rise by 12.4 billion crowns in January, not taking into account foreign transactions.
